notes.title: Patch notes since AGDQ
notes.content:
Over the last few days I've been in contact with the game's speedrunning community. Based on their feedback, some changes have been made to improve the game experience in general, but particularly with regard to speedrunning the game

- A “Speedrun Timer” option has been added, which can be activated in the game settings. This timer ignores load times and should count the same regardless of your computer's processing power (special thanks to Swooce, who practically implemented this feature for me).

- some sound effects have been modified because they were too loud.

- a super secret cheat code has been added 👀

- ghost files can be shared between players, the game now generates .gho files inside the game folder, which can be shared and imported into other people's games


A big thanks to the entire speedrun community for playing, testing and giving feedback on the game.
